Question: Odell and Kershaw run for \(30\) minutes on a circular track. Odell runs clockwise at \(250\) m/min and uses the inner lane with a radius of \(50\) meters. Kershaw runs counterclockwise at \(300\) m/min and uses the outer lane with a radius of \(60\) meters, starting on the same radial line as Odell. How many times after the start do they pass each other?
